Find, describe and call any operation of the Voidhash API: everything the dashboard can do except
paywall design. Use it in scripts, and for what has no command of its own yet.

The operations are read from the server the CLI talks to, so they are always the ones that server
has.

Usage:
  voidhash api <command> [flags]

Commands:
  list       List the operations of the Voidhash API.
  describe   Show an operation's parameters, body and response schemas, and errors.
  call       Call an operation of the Voidhash API as yourself and print its JSON response.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash api list webhooks
  voidhash api describe webhooks.create
  voidhash api call webhooks.list --query limit=5

Run 'voidhash api <command> --help' for more about a command.
